description: Defines adapter classes for connecting various SDU notifiers and handlers within the F1AP, F1-U, RLC, and MAC layers of a telecommunications protocol stack, including connection management and data handling methods.

classes.name: f1c_rx_sdu_rlc_adapter
classes.description: Adapter connecting F1AP Rx SDU notifier to RLC Tx SDU handler.

classes.name: f1u_rx_rlc_sdu_adapter
classes.description: Adapter connecting F1-U Rx SDU notifier to RLC Tx SDU handler.

classes.name: f1u_gateway_nru_rx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for F1-U Gateway to handle NR-U RX PDU messages.

classes.name: rlc_rx_rrc_sdu_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for RLC RX to handle SDUs from RLC to F1C bearer.

classes.name: rlc_f1u_tx_sdu_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for RLC TX to handle SDUs from RLC to F1U bearer.

classes.name: rlc_f1c_tx_data_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for RLC to F1-C transmission events.

classes.name: rlc_f1u_tx_data_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for RLC to F1-U transmission events.

classes.name: rlc_tx_control_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for RLC transmission control events (e.g., protocol failure, max retransmissions).

classes.name: rlc_tx_mac_buffer_state_updater
classes.description: Updates MAC buffer state based on RLC buffer status.

classes.name: mac_sdu_rx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for MAC SDU reception from RLC.

classes.name: mac_sdu_tx_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for MAC SDU transmission to RLC.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection between notifier and handler.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates connection between notifier and handler.

methods.name: on_delivered_retransmitted_sdu
methods.description: Handles notification of retransmitted SDU delivery.
